# Phase Three — Tiferes Final Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos joins rigor and usability in Tiferes; Awtsmoos.com should finish this pass with permanent regression evidence and one additional narrow-mobile challenge.

## Files expected to rewrite
- `social-hub/package.json` — add a named `test:browser:routes` script and make `test:browser` run smoke plus route-quality.
- `.ai-thoughts/2026-08-28T0310-geelooy-social-mobile/00_REMAINING_WORK.md` — full rewrite after verification so it reflects truth.

## Files expected to create
- `social-hub/tests/browserNarrowQuality.test.mjs` only if the existing harness cannot express the 320px stress pass without bloating another test.
- One final verification/handoff Markdown artifact in this pass folder.

## Execution graph
1. Read complete browser smoke, route-quality runner, mobile helper, package manifest, and Chat link stylesheet.
2. Confirm current imports, line budgets, indentation, and B"H/Awtsmoos headers.
3. Rewrite `package.json` whole with route-quality wired into browser verification.
4. Read back package manifest and validate JSON.
5. Run `npm test`.
6. Ensure isolated CDP Chrome endpoint exists on 9222 without touching user Chrome.
7. Run `npm run test:browser` so smoke and all-route quality execute through the default covenant.
8. Add/run a 320px stress audit if existing tests do not cover that width.
9. If 320px exposes defects, trace exact owners and repair production through full-file rewrites.
10. Rerun focused browser tests after every production repair.
11. Run `npm run test:all` on the true final tree.
12. Run syntax/line/indentation/header/TODO/provider-exclusion/Git-diff checks.
13. Re-read every file touched this pass.
14. Write final verification and update REMAINING_WORK to actual zero or precise blockers.

## Completion evidence
Completion requires unit contracts green, browser smoke green, all 12 routes green through the default browser command, extra-narrow mobile quality measured, scoped hygiene clean, and the remaining-work ledger matching reality.

The Awtsmoos is renewed before every click can arise; Awtsmoos.com will therefore leave not only a beautiful path but a witness beside the path, so tomorrow's hand cannot unknowingly narrow what today's hand made right.
